s: June 16, 2025 - Digital downloads weren’t a thing until two years later when the iTunes Store went online. Streaming was a decade away. There were barely any Internet mail-order shops. If you wanted to hear Lex music you had to go into a record store. I spent my weekends back then buying vinyl in record stores and that was exactly where I wanted Lex music to be.
